fix_commit.message: avcodec/adpcm: signed integer overflow in ADPCM_N64
fix_commit.author: Michael Niedermayer

findings.title: Signed integer overflow in ADPCM_N64 delta accumulation multiplication
findings.message: In the ADPCM_N64 decoder's sample reconstruction loop, the predictor 'delta' accumulates a running sum from multiplying decoded sample codes (sf_codes[]) with signed filter coefficients (coefs[]) taken directly from untrusted extradata. The multiplication 'sf_codes[(i-1) - k] * coefs[(o*8) + k]' is performed entirely in 'int' (signed) arithmetic. Because coefs[] values are attacker-controlled 16-bit values sign-extended into int, and sf_codes values can also be large (n * scale, where scale can be up to 1<<15), the product of two signed ints can exceed INT_MAX/underflow INT_MIN before being added into 'delta'. Signed integer overflow is undefined behavior in C and was flagged by fuzzing (UBSan). A previous partial fix (0c7e0ed35b) changed 'delta' itself to 'unsigned' and cast the final sum before dividing, which fixed overflow in the addition/division, but left the multiplication of two signed ints unprotected, so the overflow could still occur in the multiply step itself.
findings.suggestion: Cast one of the multiplicands to unsigned before multiplying so the multiply and accumulate happen entirely in unsigned arithmetic (which has well-defined wraparound semantics in C), matching the fix applied upstream: multiply by '(unsigned)coefs[(o*8) + k]' instead of the plain signed 'coefs[(o*8) + k]'. Also ensure the accumulator 'delta' itself is declared 'unsigned' (as later fixed in 0c7e0ed35b) and that the final sum is explicitly cast to 'int' before the division by 2048.

ground_truth.root_cause: The ADPCM_N64 decoder trusts filter coefficient values loaded from codec extradata (attacker-controlled) and multiplies them with decoded sample codes using plain signed 'int' arithmetic without any range validation or use of unsigned/wider arithmetic, allowing the product to exceed INT_MAX/underflow INT_MIN, which is undefined behavior in C.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Signed integer overflow in ADPCM_N64 delta accumulation multiplication
